title: A named source root keeps a stale claim fence after the claim lapses and is reclaimed, so the next launcher run is refused only at launch
outcome: When a session's claim lapses and is reclaimed, the session learns that its named source root must be named again before it next runs the launcher (for example, the reclaim or a read of the root's status says so), so a queued launch is not spent on a run that the host refuses at its first step.
acceptance: A named source root keeps a stale claim fence after the claim lapses and is reclaimed, so the next launcher run is refused only at launch is done
